label: Internet of Things by NACE Rev. 2 activity

size_emp.label: Size classes in number of persons employed

nace_r2.label: Statistical classification of economic activities in the European Community (NACE Rev. 2)

label.C10-C12: Manufacture of food products; beverages and tobacco products

label.E_IOT: Enterprises use IoT (interconnected devices or systems that can be monitored or remotely controlled via the internet) (until 2020)
label.E_IOTDEC: Enterprises use smart meters, smart lamps, smart thermostats to optimise energy consumption in the enterprise's premises (until 2020)
label.E_IOTDEC1: Enterprises use IoT for energy consumption management (e.g. smart-meters, -thermostats, -lights) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDCUS: Enterprises use sensors, RFID or IP tags or internet-controlled cameras to improve customer service, monitor customers' activities or offer them a personalised shopping experience (until 2020)
label.E_IOTDMTN: Enterprises use movement or maintenance sensors to track the movement of vehicles or products, to offer condition-based maintenance of vehicles (until 2020)
label.E_IOTDPRD: Enterprises use sensors or RFID tags to monitor or automate production processes, to manage logistics, to track the movement of products (until 2020)
label.E_IOTDSEC: Enterprises use IoT for premises' security (e.g. smart-alarm systems, -smoke detectors, -door locks, -security cameras) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDPP: Enterprises use IoT for production processes (e.g. sensors or RFID tags to monitor or automate the production processes) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDLOG: Enterprises use IoT for logistics management (e.g. sensors for tracking products or vehicles in warehouse management) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDMTN1: Enterprises use IoT for condition-based maintenance (e.g. sensors to monitor maintenance needs of machines or vehicles) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDCUS1: Enterprises use IoT for customer service (e.g. smart cameras or sensors to offer customers a personalised shopping experience) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDOTH: Enterprises use other IoT devices or systems (than IOTDEC, IOTDCUS, IOTDMTN, IOTDPRD) (until 2020)
label.E_IOTDOTH1: Enterprises use IoT for other purposes (than IOTDEC1, IOTDSEC, IOTDPP, IOTDLOG, IOTDMTN1, IOTDCUS1)
label.E_IOTD_GE2: Enterprises use two or more IoT devices or systems (until 2020)
label.E_IOTD1_GE1: Enterprises use IoT for one or more purposes of: IOTDEC1, IOTDSEC, IOTDPP, IOTDLOG, IOTDMTN1, IOTDCUS1, IOTDOTH1
label.E_IOTD1_GE2: Enterprises use IoT for two or more purposes of: IOTDEC1, IOTDSEC, IOTDPP, IOTDLOG, IOTDMTN1, IOTDCUS1, IOTDOTH1
label.E_IOTD1_GE3: Enterprises use IoT for three or more purposes of: IOTDEC1, IOTDSEC, IOTDPP, IOTDLOG, IOTDMTN1, IOTDCUS1, IOTDOTH1
label.E_IOT1: Enterprises use IoT (interconnected devices or systems that can be monitored or remotely controlled via the internet) (as of 2021)
label.E_IOTDPRD1: Enterprises use IoT for production processes or logistics management (as of 2021)
label.E_BDA_IOT: Enterprises analysing big data internally (from any data source) or externally and using IoT (until 2020)
label.E_BDA_IOTX: Enterprises analysing big data internally (from any data source) or externally but not using IoT (until 2020)
